description: This file defines the LoggingFactory class, which provides a factory method for creating MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries used for logging purposes. It primarily encapsulates object creation and hides concrete implementations related to logging.

classes.name: LoggingFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing factory methods for creating logging-related objects, specifically MDC entries.

methods.name: newMdcEntry
methods.description: Creates a new MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entry with the specified key and value, returning an immutable object.
